Coffee & A Roll Sunday Ride

Wilmington, NC · Greenfield Lake · Road

Coffee & A Roll Sunday Ride is a road group ride in Wilmington, NC. It rolls every Sunday at 8:00 am from Greenfield Lake Park, main parking lot.

How we know

Cape Fear Cyclists' calendar (fetched Oct 1, 2026) lists Coffee And A Roll (Mitch's) Sunday Ride on Sept 27 and Oct 4, 11, 18 and 25; the Sept 27 event page says 8:00 AM from Greenfield Lake Park (main lot), Class D, 25 to 35 miles with a Panera stop in Mayfaire.

About the Coffee & A Roll Sunday Ride group ride

A relaxed Sunday club ride that loops through Wilmington with a coffee stop at Mayfaire. You should be comfortable shifting, braking and riding near others. Bring a spare tube. Cancelled below 38°F or on wet roads.
